targets.query:
// pcs/min real via delta por janela de 1 minuto (mais estável que derivative quando a amostragem é irregular)
// Compat: aceitamos schema novo (prometheus/name) e antigo (s7_db1/_field).
// Entrada do operador: pcs/h. Conversão central: nominal_min = nominal_h/60.
nominal_h = float(v: ${planned_rate_h:raw})
nominal_min = nominal_h / 60.0
scale = 1.0 / float(v: ${pulses_per_piece:raw})
max_per_min = if nominal_min > 0.0 then (nominal_min * 3.0) else 500.0

get = (metric) =>
  union(tables: [
    from(bucket: "processo")
      |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus" and r.name == metric)
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r["ip"] =~ /^${ip:regex}$/ or "${ip:raw}" == ""),
    from(bucket: "processo")
      |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "s7_db1" and r._field == metric)
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r["ip"] =~ /^${ip:regex}$/ or "${ip:raw}" == "")
  ])

good = get(metric: "contador_bom")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: last, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(usePrevious: true)
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) * scale }))

bad = get(metric: "contador_ruim")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: last, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(usePrevious: true)
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) * scale }))

union(tables: [good, bad])
  |> group(columns: ["_time"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value >= 0.0 and r._value < max_per_min)
  |> fill(column: "_value", value: 0.0)
  |> last()

scale = 1.0 / float(v: ${pulses_per_piece:raw})

get = (metric) =>

panels.description: Performance do turno (hoje) = produção do turno ÷ (taxa nominal × duração do turno). Nota: este painel é equivalente ao 'Atingimento (turno) (%)' (mesma fórmula produced/meta); mantemos ambos por clareza para operação.

targets.query:
import "date"
import "strings"

mode = "${shift_mode}"
shift = "${shift}"

// Horário local da planta: America/Sao_Paulo (UTC-3).
// O Influx roda em UTC, então o range() precisa ser UTC = local + 3h.
localOffset = 3h

// escala: se o PLC contar pulsos, converte para peças (pulsos/peça)
scale = 1.0 / float(v: ${pulses_per_piece:raw})

// horários vindos das variáveis (HH:MM, sempre em horário local)
startStr = if shift == "1" then "${shift1_start}" else if shift == "2" then "${shift2_start}" else "${shift3_start}"
endStr   = if shift == "1" then "${shift1_end}"   else if shift == "2" then "${shift2_end}"   else "${shift3_end}"

// Base do dia atual (em UTC) e construção dos horários do turno.
// Aqui rawStart/rawEnd ainda representam os HH:MM escolhidos, e ajustamos cruzamento de meia-noite.
today = string(v: date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1d))
startISO = strings.replaceAll(v: today, t: "00:00:00Z", u: startStr + ":00Z")
endISO   = strings.replaceAll(v: today, t: "00:00:00Z", u: endStr + ":00Z")

rawStart = time(v: startISO)
rawEnd   = time(v: endISO)
endAdj = if rawEnd <= rawStart then rawEnd + 24h else rawEnd

// Converte janela local -> UTC
startT = if mode == "Turno" then rawStart + localOffset else v.timeRangeStart
stopT  = if mode == "Turno" then endAdj + localOffset   else v.timeRangeStop

// Entrada do operador: pcs/h. Conversão central: nominal_min = nominal_h/60.
nominal_h = float(v: ${planned_rate_h:raw})
nominal_min = nominal_h / 60.0

get = (metric) =>
  union(tables: [
    from(bucket: "processo")
      |> range(start: startT, stop: stopT)
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus" and r.name == metric)
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r["ip"] =~ /^${ip:regex}$/ or "${ip:raw}" == ""),
    from(bucket: "processo")
      |> range(start: startT, stop: stopT)
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "s7_db1" and r._field == metric)
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r["ip"] =~ /^${ip:regex}$/ or "${ip:raw}" == "")
  ])

prod_good = get(metric: "contador_bom")
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) * scale }))

prod_bad = get(metric: "contador_ruim")
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) * scale }))

produced = union(tables: [prod_good, prod_bad])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ kind: "produced", _value: float(v: r._value) }))
  |> keep(columns: ["kind", "_value"])

// minutos totais do turno (aprox.) via reamostragem
minutes_total = get(metric: "maquina_ligada")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(value: 0.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _value: 1.0 }))
  |> sum()

meta = minutes_total
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ kind: "meta", _value: float(v: r._value) * nominal_min }))
  |> keep(columns: ["kind", "_value"])

union(tables: [produced, meta])
  |> pivot(rowKey: [], columnKey: ["kind"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _value: if nominal_min > 0.0 and float(v: r.meta) > 0.0 then (float(v: r.produced) / float(v: r.meta)) * 100.0 else 0.0 }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r._value < 0.0 then 0.0 else if r._value > 200.0 then 200.0 else r._value }))
  |> last()

// Reusa a mesma lógica de Performance real (turno) – é o mesmo cálculo (produced/meta)
// Mantido em painel separado para deixar claro para operação
import "date"
import "strings"

mode = "${shift_mode}"
shift = "${shift}"

// Horário local da planta: America/Sao_Paulo (UTC-3).
// O Influx roda em UTC, então o range() precisa ser UTC = local + 3h.
localOffset = 3h

// escala: se o PLC contar pulsos, converte para peças (pulsos/peça)
scale = 1.0 / float(v: ${pulses_per_piece:raw})

startStr = if shift == "1" then "${shift1_start}" else if shift == "2" then "${shift2_start}" else "${shift3_start}"
endStr   = if shift == "1" then "${shift1_end}"   else if shift == "2" then "${shift2_end}"   else "${shift3_end}"

today = string(v: date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1d))
startISO = strings.replaceAll(v: today, t: "00:00:00Z", u: startStr + ":00Z")
endISO   = strings.replaceAll(v: today, t: "00:00:00Z", u: endStr + ":00Z")

rawStart = time(v: startISO)
rawEnd   = time(v: endISO)
endAdj = if rawEnd <= rawStart then rawEnd + 24h else rawEnd

startT = if mode == "Turno" then rawStart + localOffset else v.timeRangeStart
stopT  = if mode == "Turno" then endAdj + localOffset   else v.timeRangeStop

// Entrada do operador: pcs/h. Conversão central: nominal_min = nominal_h/60.
nominal_h = float(v: ${planned_rate_h:raw})
nominal_min = nominal_h / 60.0

get = (metric) =>
  union(tables: [
    from(bucket: "processo")
      |> range(start: startT, stop: stopT)
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus" and r.name == metric)
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r["ip"] =~ /^${ip:regex}$/ or "${ip:raw}" == ""),
    from(bucket: "processo")
      |> range(start: startT, stop: stopT)
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "s7_db1" and r._field == metric)
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r["ip"] =~ /^${ip:regex}$/ or "${ip:raw}" == "")
  ])

prod_good = get(metric: "contador_bom")
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) * scale }))

prod_bad = get(metric: "contador_ruim")
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) * scale }))

produced = union(tables: [prod_good, prod_bad])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ kind: "produced", _value: float(v: r._value) }))
  |> keep(columns: ["kind", "_value"])

minutes_total = get(metric: "maquina_ligada")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(value: 0.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _value: 1.0 }))
  |> sum()

meta = minutes_total
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ kind: "meta", _value: float(v: r._value) * nominal_min }))
  |> keep(columns: ["kind", "_value"])

union(tables: [produced, meta])
  |> pivot(rowKey: [], columnKey: ["kind"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _value: if nominal_min > 0.0 and float(v: r.meta) > 0.0 then (float(v: r.produced) / float(v: r.meta)) * 100.0 else 0.0 }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r._value < 0.0 then 0.0 else if r._value > 200.0 then 200.0 else r._value }))
  |> last()

// pcs/min por minuto (delta do contador) – PRODUÇÃO TOTAL (boas + ruins)
// Compat: aceita schema novo (prometheus/name) e antigo (s7_db1/_field).
// Entrada do operador: pcs/h. Conversão central: nominal_min = nominal_h/60.
nominal_h = float(v: ${planned_rate_h:raw})
nominal_min = nominal_h / 60.0
scale = 1.0 / float(v: ${pulses_per_piece:raw})
max_per_min = if nominal_min > 0.0 then (nominal_min * 3.0) else 500.0

get2h = (metric) =>
  union(tables: [
    from(bucket: "processo")
      |> range(start: -2h)
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus" and r.name == metric)
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r["ip"] =~ /^${ip:regex}$/ or "${ip:raw}" == ""),
    from(bucket: "processo")
      |> range(start: -2h)
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "s7_db1" and r._field == metric)
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r["ip"] =~ /^${ip:regex}$/ or "${ip:raw}" == "")
  ])

good = get2h(metric: "contador_bom")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: last, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(usePrevious: true)
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) * scale }))

bad = get2h(metric: "contador_ruim")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: last, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(usePrevious: true)
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) * scale }))

union(tables: [good, bad])
  |> sum()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value >= 0.0 and r._value < max_per_min)
  |> fill(column: "_value", value: 0.0)

panels.title: Debug: deltas por minuto (bom/ruim/total)
panels.description: Use este painel para bater com a produção real: ele mostra quantas peças/min saíram (boas e ruins) e o total. (1 pulso = 1 peça com pulses_per_piece=1).

targets.query:
// Compat: aceita schema novo (prometheus/name) e antigo (s7_db1/_field).
scale = 1.0 / float(v: ${pulses_per_piece:raw})

mk = (metric) =>
  union(tables: [
    from(bucket: "processo")
      |> range(start: -2h)
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus" and r.name == metric)
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r["ip"] =~ /^${ip:regex}$/ or "${ip:raw}" == ""),
    from(bucket: "processo")
      |> range(start: -2h)
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "s7_db1" and r._field == metric)
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r["ip"] =~ /^${ip:regex}$/ or "${ip:raw}" == "")
  ])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: last, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(usePrevious: true)
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) * scale }))

good = mk(metric: "contador_bom") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with serie: "bom" }))
bad  = mk(metric: "contador_ruim") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with serie: "ruim" }))

total = union(tables: [mk(metric: "contador_bom"), mk(metric: "contador_ruim")])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with serie: "total" }))

union(tables: [good, bad, total])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "serie"])
